adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततो दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुं कालचक्रमिवागतम्। नारसिंहवपुश्छन्नं भस्माच्छन्नमिवानलम्॥१॥
verses.english: Clad in brilliant silks of ochry yellow, adorned with superfine golden ornaments on his smokily blue-black body, he rose up like the fulmination at the end of an era...
verses.bhavadeepa: ददर्शेत्यत्र ददृशे इति स्वरभक्त्याक्षरपूर्णं ज्ञेयम्। दन्तगवाक्षाः “झरोका” इति भाषायां प्रसिद्धाः॥२१॥
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: विकुञ्चितसटं तस्य नारसिंहस्य भारत। रूपौदार्य बभौ तत्र सहस्रशशिसन्निभम्॥२॥
verses.english: Demon मय getting into a four-wheeled chariot entirely made with gold; as broad as twelve hundred cubits; voyages through divers and difficult routes in space, water, or earth; well-equipped with outrageous weaponry...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: अहो रूपमिदं चित्रं शङ्खकुन्देन्दुसन्निभम्। अब्रुवन्दानवाः सर्वे हिरण्यकशिपुश्च सः॥३॥
verses.english: Furnished with jangling swags of tinkling-bells; upholstered with tiger skins; adorned with latticed jewel and gold drapes...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: एव हि ब्रुवतां तेषां निर्दग्धानां महात्मनाम्। नारसिंहेन चक्षुर्भ्यां चोदिताः कालधर्मणा॥४॥
verses.english: Stands high among all the best chariots; rider’s cabin - सूप-स्थानम् - merits comparison with a mountain; assorted with numerous– ईहामृग गण = कृत्रिम सत्त्व समूह - artificial beings, say androids, pongoids etc robots inclusive of avinoids; stockpiles many celestial missiles and quivers; peals like thundering cloud...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्रः प्रह्रादो नाम वीर्यवान्। दिव्येन चक्षुषा सिंहमपश्यद्देवमागतम्॥५॥
verses.english: Stretching his huge bow of many thousand cubits in dimension, the demon named वराह also stood in the van of army with saggy matted hair – स अवरोह - like a fig tree covered with slouching branches...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा रुक्मशैलाभमपूर्वां तनुमास्थितम्। विस्मिता दानवाः सर्वे हिरण्यकशिपुश्च सः॥६॥
verses.english: Stands high among all the best chariots; rider’s cabin - सूप-स्थानम् - merits comparison with a mountain; assorted with numerous– ईहामृग गण = कृत्रिम सत्त्व समूह - artificial beings, say androids, pongoids etc robots inclusive of avinoids; stockpiles many celestial missiles and quivers; peals like thundering cloud...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्राद उवाच।
              महाराज महाबाहो दैत्यानामादिसम्भव। न श्रुतं नैव दृष्टं च नारसिंहमिदं वपुः॥७॥
verses.english: Encharioted on such an effulgent and breathtaking chariot that can trounce enemy chariots, demon मय, थे warmonger, shone forth like the sun on his ascension to the top of loftiest Mt. मेरु॥।
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तप्रभवं दिव्यं किमिदं रूपमद्भुतम्। दैत्यान्तकरणं घोरं शंसतीव मनांसि नः॥८॥
verses.english: Its beadings and the chassis-to yoke-beam are golden; when its flags and flag staffs are skyrocketing to touch the sun, it glittered like the sun itself against the backdrop of Mt. मन्दर; comparable to a huge elephant and a vast ocean, it looks bearish and in plunge, it is lionish; it is fraught with a thousand bears, say ursine creatures, say ursoidal robos; its clangouring is like the clang from a mass of thousand clouds...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: अस्य देवाः शरीरस्थाः सागराः सरितस्तथा। हिमवान्पारियात्रश्च ये चान्ये कुलपर्वताः॥९॥
verses.english: Encharioted on such an effulgent and breathtaking chariot that can trounce enemy chariots, demon मय, थे warmonger, shone forth like the sun on his ascension to the top of loftiest Mt. मेरु॥।
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रमाः सह नक्षत्रैरादित्याश्चाश्विनौ तथा। धनदो वरुणश्चैव यमः शक्रः शचीपतिः॥१०॥
verses.english: Demon तार on his part enmcharioted on a chariot that is widthwise some two miles, hoisting a flag with crow symbol; its structure resemblant of a huge collection of mountains, or a heap of mascara; its eight wheels, chassis-yoke coupler etc are all made of cast-iron; aglow with sable and cindery flashes; thundering like black clouds...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: मरुतो देवगन्धर्वा मुनयश्च तपोधनाः। नागा यक्षाः पिशाचाश्च राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः॥११॥
verses.english: Demon अरिष्ट, the son of बलि, stood there wielding huge boulder-shots, and though looked tired he is something like an iron mountain...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदेवः पशुपतिर्ललाटस्था विभान्ति वै। स्थावराणि च भूतानि जङ्गमानि तथैव च॥१२॥
verses.english: And demon तार encharioted such a best chariot that is surging by reason of its enemies, looking next only to Mt, मन्दर, and yoked with a thousand donkeys...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: भवांश्च सहितोऽस्माभिः सर्वैर्दैत्यगणैर्वृतः। विमानशतसङ्कीर्णा तथाभ्यन्तरजा सभा॥१३॥
verses.english: The highly enraged demon विरोचन taking up a club stood in the van of army like a mountain with outstanding summits...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं त्रिभुवनं राजँल्लोकधर्मश्च शाश्वतः। दृश्यते नारासिंहेऽस्मिन्यथेन्दौ विमलं जगत्॥१४॥
verses.english: Demon हय-ग्रीव, who is the repressor of the armies of his co-brothers - सपत्न-आनीकम् - namely gods, embarked on a chariot drawn by a thousand steeds...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिश्चात्र मनुर्महात्मा ग्रहाश्च योगाश्च मही नभश्च। उत्पातकालश्च धृतिः स्मृतिश्च रजश्च सत्त्वं च तपो दमश्च॥१५॥
verses.english: Stretching his huge bow of many thousand cubits in dimension, the demon named वराह also stood in the van of army with saggy matted hair – स अवरोह - like a fig tree covered with slouching branches...
verses.bhavadeepa: yथा महादर्शकल्पे चन्द्रमण्डले चक्षुर्धारयतां कृत्स्नं जगद्दृष्टिगोचरीभवत्यस्येति योगिप्रसिद्धोऽयं दृष्टान्तः॥१४॥
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारश्च महानुभावो विश्वे च देवाप्सरसश्च सर्वाः। क्रोधश्च कामश्च तथैव हर्षो दर्पश्च मोहः पितरश्च सर्वे॥१६॥
verses.english: Shedding tears of anger out of haughtiness the demon खर stood hankering for the battle while his lips quivered, teeth gnashed and face trembled...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्ता स च दैत्यराजं हिरण्यनामानमविस्मयेन। दध्यौ च दैत्येश्वरपुत्र उग्रं महामतिः किञ्चिदधोमुखः प्राक्॥१७॥
verses.english: The demon श्वेत, the son of विप्रचित्ति, wearing white ear-hangings, stood in the van of war reminding a white mountain...
verses.adhyaya_name: नृसिंहं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां विस्मयः प्रह्रादवाक्यं च
